newsitem.title: RUSSIA: China says Yeltsin likely to visit in November.
newsitem.headline: China says Yeltsin likely to visit in November.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin accepted an invitation to visit China from President Jiang Zemin on Wednesday and the trip will probably go ahead in November, a Chinese spokesman said.

"Chairman Jiang invited President Boris Yeltsin to come and visit China at any time convenient for him. Yeltsin said he was ready to visit China in the autumn," Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesman Shen Guofang told reporters in Moscow.
"No precise time has been set but we assume it could be November."
Yeltsin and Jiang, who is on a five-day visit to Moscow, signed a declaration on Wednesday opposing the dominance of one superpower in the post-Cold War world.
Yeltsin last visited China a year ago, when Moscow and Beijing pledged to build a strategic partnership for the next century.
